_comment: Day rhythm and special days for the pet. rhythm: from/to are local hours (to is exclusive, from > to wraps past midnight); active/rest/sleep multiply how often the pet picks lively, calm or sleeping actions. events: date is MM-DD every year, or dates gives the day per year (lunar holidays); from/to are day offsets around it (e.g. from -1 starts the day before). Each event id is also a line category in lines.json; active (optional) makes the pet livelier that day. birthday uses the user's birthday from Settings; anniversary is the yearly day the pet first met the user. Earlier events win when several fall on the same day. Restart the AI after editing; publish again to update the standalone copy.
